sourceRefs.locator: Object no. 66.245.10, Overview: clay, ca. 20th–19th century BCE and probable Kültepe provenance; object description: caravan costs and Assyrian trade network
text no. 75 (MMA 66.245.10), pp. 98–101, plates 72–73, translation lines 5–37 and Remarks: tin, textiles, seven donkeys, fodder, equipment, silver outlays and two shipments
Description, Lower Town-Karum and Assyrian Trading Colonies Period: trade quarter, housing and network context

note.de: Der Text nennt die Kosten zweier Lieferungen. Die Zuordnung dieser Tafel zu Kültepe ist wahrscheinlich. Der Kartenpunkt dient zur Orientierung in der Unterstadt.
note.en: The text records expenses for two shipments. This tablet probably comes from Kültepe. The map point locates the lower town.
